name: Flip Card
description: A framework-free Web Component that turns a card about its middle to show what is written on the back, keeping the face turned away out of the page rather than merely out of sight.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A picture on the front, details and a link on the back, turned by a press or by the button.

variants.name: Grid
variants.description: Six cards turning independently, none of them moving the ones beside it.

variants.name: Content
variants.description: A back carrying a working button and link, and a card whose toggle the author wrote.

variants.name: Sizes
variants.description: Wide, tall, and a back with more on it than the card is tall.

variants.name: States
variants.description: A card with no back, one opened on its back, a picture that never arrived, and reduced motion.
